recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13101; any future regression in modern spreadsheet tooling should be handled in the external tooling repository rather than in current core source.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue, raised and applied for DSTU2, asking to add the ability to capture ElementDefinition.type.versioning when declaring spreadsheet types, motivated by SDC QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire and expected future uses.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 11835. The matching git-svn commit 490badf6923a12bdc3064e398ebe129378780c98, dated 2017-03-24, added ReferenceVersionRules storage to the old TypeRef spreadsheet model and propagated parsed versioning into TypeRefComponent.versioning in TypeParser.
additional_context: The old tools/java/org.hl7.fhir.igtools spreadsheet parser was later removed from this checkout after the IG publisher moved to Maven. Current source/fhir.ini keeps ElementDefinition and QuestionnaireResponse in build scope, source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml defines ElementDefinition.type.versioning, and current QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire is canonical(Questionnaire). Current canonical-reference guidance permits url|version, so the SDC QuestionnaireResponse target-version use case is covered without a missing Reference type.versioning declaration. Source and community searches found no current core spreadsheet use of the historical parser syntax and no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk was needed because the historical tooling support was applied and the current authoritative source already represents the relevant model and QuestionnaireResponse version-reference behavior.

related_jiras.note: Underlying issue that added ElementDefinition.type.versioning and ReferenceVersionRules; decided opportunistically in this run.
